questions.question: Which package manager / build tool should be used, and what exact command installs dependencies?
questions.truth: uv. `uv sync` (CI: `uv sync --locked --extra all`; the dev dependency group installs by default). uv.lock is committed.
reject: pip install -e . or pip install -e '.[all]' = 0.5 (works, ignores uv.lock and dev groups)

questions.question: What exact command runs the full test suite?
questions.truth: `bash scripts/run-tests.sh` (renamed from scripts/test.sh; same pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/). CI uses scripts/test-cov.sh, which calls run-tests.sh. `uv run pytest` also works.
accept: bash scripts/run-tests.sh / uv run bash scripts/run-tests.sh

questions.question: What exact command runs only the tests in tests/test_application.py?
questions.truth: `uv run pytest tests/test_application.py`. `scripts/run-tests.sh <file>` still runs everything; `scripts/test.sh` no longer exists.

questions.question: What exact command(s) check lint/formatting the way CI does?
questions.truth: CI runs pre-commit via prek (ruff check, ruff format, mypy fastapi, ty check, ...). Local equivalent: `bash scripts/check-style.sh` (renamed from scripts/lint.sh) = mypy fastapi; ty check; ruff check ...; ruff format --check.
accept: uv run prek run --all-files (or pre-commit run --all-files)
explicit ruff check + ruff format --check + mypy fastapi (ty check a bonus)

questions.question: Name files or directories in this repo that are generated or vendored and must not be edited by hand (or say none).
questions.truth: uv.lock (tool-managed); README.md is generated from docs/en/docs/index.md (pre-commit hook generate-readme); docs/en/overrides/partials/banner-sponsors.html is generated from docs/en/data/sponsors.yml (render-banner-sponsors hook); coverage/ and htmlcov are build outputs.
accept: Score 1 if it names at least one of: uv.lock, README.md (generated from docs/en/docs/index.md), banner-sponsors.html partial, coverage/htmlcov outputs
reject: claiming fastapi/ or docs_src/ source is generated
